title: Still Life & Flowers
description: Quiet arrangements of fruit, flowers, and objects — beauty in the everyday.

items.title: Still Life with Flowers
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas painting presents a vibrant floral arrangement, characteristic of Odilon Redon's expressive and often imaginative approach to still life. Created in 1905, it exemplifies his masterful use of color and light.
items.tags: still life, flowers, symbolism, post-impressionism, vibrant, expressive, oil painting

items.title: Still Life with Flowers
items.description_narrative: Henri Fantin-Latour's 'Still Life with Flowers' from 1881 presents a delicate arrangement of blossoms, rendered with meticulous detail in oil on canvas. This work exemplifies the artist's renowned skill in capturing the subtle beauty and texture of floral subjects.
items.tags: still life, flowers, oil painting, 19th century, french art, realism, botanical

items.title: Trompe-l'Oeil Still Life with a Flower Garland and a Curtain
items.description_narrative: This intricate still life, titled Trompe-l'Oeil Still Life with a Flower Garland and a Curtain, presents a masterful illusion designed to deceive the viewer's eye. Adriaen van der Spelt meticulously renders a flower garland seemingly peeking from behind a drawn curtain, demonstrating the artist's skill in creating depth and realism.
items.tags: still life, trompe-l'oeil, illusion, flowers, curtain, realism, dutch golden age, painting

items.title: Still-Life with a Green Flower Vase
items.medium: Oil on brown wood pulp board, varnished
items.description_narrative: This still life by Paula Modersohn-Becker features a vibrant green flower vase holding a small bouquet. Painted with oil on brown wood pulp board, the work demonstrates the artist's distinctive style and material exploration.
items.tags: still life, flowers, vase, oil painting, early modern, German, expressionism

items.title: Still Life with Flower Arrangement in Pot
items.medium: Watercolor over graphite, with gold paper additions, on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: This still life features a vibrant flower arrangement presented in a pot. The artwork utilizes watercolor over graphite, enhanced by delicate gold paper additions, all rendered on cream wove paper.
items.tags: still life, flowers, botanical, watercolor, mixed media, floral

items.title: Still Life with Grapes and Flowers
items.description_narrative: Mélanie de Comoléra's oil on canvas depicts a traditional still life arrangement. This work features lush grapes and vibrant flowers, meticulously rendered to capture their natural beauty around 1827.
items.tags: still life, grapes, flowers, oil painting, botanical, romantic era, naturalistic

items.title: Magnolias on Light Blue Velvet Cloth
items.description_narrative: Martin Johnson Heade meticulously renders the delicate beauty of magnolias arranged against a luxurious light blue velvet cloth. This oil painting captures the luminous petals and dark leaves, creating a striking contrast and an intimate still life composition.
items.tags: magnolias, flowers, still life, oil painting, american art, 19th century, nature

items.title: For Sunday's Dinner
items.description_narrative: This detailed still life depicts various elements gathered for a meal, including provisions and kitchen utensils. William Michael Harnett masterfully renders these everyday objects with a striking realism, inviting viewers to discern the painted from the actual.
items.tags: still life, trompe l'oeil, food, realism, domestic, hyperrealism, kitchenware

items.title: A Vanitas Still Life with a Flag, Candlestick, Musical Instruments, Books, Writing Paraphernalia, Globes, and Hourglass
items.description_narrative: This still life by Edwaert Collier features an array of symbolic objects including an hourglass, musical instruments, and writing paraphernalia. These meticulously rendered items, set against a dark backdrop, serve as a contemplation on the transient nature of life and earthly possessions.
items.tags: vanitas, still life, oil painting, memento mori, Dutch Golden Age, symbolism, 17th century

items.title: The Irish Question
items.description_narrative: De Scott Evans' *The Irish Question* offers a visual commentary on the complex political and social issues surrounding Ireland in the late 19th century. This oil on canvas piece invites contemplation on themes of nationalism and governance pertinent to its era.
items.tags: political art, social commentary, irish history, 19th century, american art, oil painting

items.title: Still Life with Dead Game, Fruits, and Vegetables in a Market
items.description_narrative: This monumental still life by Frans Snyders depicts a lavish market scene overflowing with an array of dead game, vibrant fruits, and diverse vegetables. Executed in oil on canvas, the work showcases the artist's mastery in rendering textures and abundance.
items.tags: still life, game, food, market, baroque, flemish, abundance, opulent

items.title: Just Dessert
items.description_narrative: William Michael Harnett, a master of trompe l'oeil, created this highly realistic still life. "Just Dessert" showcases his meticulous attention to detail, characteristic of his illusionistic compositions.
items.tags: still life, trompe l'oeil, realism, American art, 19th century, dessert, food, illusionistic

items.title: Fish (Still Life)
items.description_narrative: Édouard Manet's "Fish (Still Life)" presents a raw and unadorned depiction of marine life, characteristic of his direct and modern approach to painting. Executed in oil on canvas in 1864, this work exemplifies his departure from traditional, idealized still life compositions.
items.tags: still life, fish, realism, modern art, oil painting, 19th century, french art

items.title: Apples and Grapes
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet's 'Apples and Grapes' from 1880 showcases a vibrant still life, meticulously rendered with oil on canvas. This intimate portrayal of fruit exemplifies the artist's keen observation and masterly play of light.
items.tags: still life, fruit, impressionism, oil painting, french art, 19th century, tabletop

items.title: Chrysanthemums
items.description_narrative: Pierre-Auguste Renoir's 'Chrysanthemums' captures the vibrant beauty of a floral arrangement with characteristic Impressionistic brushwork. Painted with oil on canvas between 1881 and 1882, this work exemplifies his masterful use of color and light.
items.tags: chrysanthemums, flowers, still life, impressionism, nature, painting, vibrant

items.title: Apples
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas depicts a still life of apples, a classic subject within art history. Created by Henri Matisse in 1916, the work reflects his ongoing exploration of color and form.
items.tags: still life, modern art, french art, fauvism, oil painting, fruit, color

items.title: Fruit Piece
items.description_narrative: Hannah Brown Skeele's 'Fruit Piece' is a still life painting, skillfully rendered in oil on canvas. Created in 1860, this work exemplifies the artist's engagement with the genre of depicting natural subjects.
items.tags: still life, fruit, oil painting, 19th century, american art

items.title: Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.
items.description_narrative: Raphaelle Peale's 'Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.', painted in oil on wood panel in 1822, meticulously renders a modest array of fruit and nuts. This work exemplifies her precise command of realism, imbuing ordinary objects with a palpable presence.
items.tags: still life, strawberries, nuts, realism, oil painting, American art, 19th century
